name: weather
description: Query weather for a city using Open-Meteo API

city.description: City name in English, e.g. Beijing

name: time_now
description: Get the current system time and date

name: calc
description: Evaluate a simple math expression

name: web_search
description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo

name: todo_list
description: Manage a persistent todo list (read/add/done/clear)

name: note_save
description: Save a text note

name: note_read
description: Read a saved note

name: note_list
description: List all saved notes

name: skill_register
description: Register a new solidified skill from a workflow demonstration. Once registered, skills execute locally in <1 second.

name.description: Display name of the skill, e.g. 'Organize Reports'

steps.description: List of tool steps, each with 'tool' and 'args' keys

name: skill_list
description: List all solidified skills, optionally filtered by category (research/competition/dev/office/general)

name: skill_execute
description: Execute a solidified skill locally, achieving sub-second response without LLM routing

name.description: Name of the skill to execute

params.description: Optional parameter overrides for the skill steps

name: skill_delete
description: Delete a registered solidified skill

name.description: Name of the skill to delete

name: file_organize
description: Organize files in a directory by extension, date, or pattern. Groups files into subdirectories automatically.

dry_run.description: If true, preview changes without moving files

name: text_stats
description: Analyze text statistics: word count, character count, reading time, language detection. Useful for research papers, reports, and documents.

file_path.description: Path to a file to analyze

name: batch_rename
description: Batch rename files in a directory using prefix, suffix, replace, or serial numbering rules.

path.description: Directory path containing files to rename

name: project_init
description: Scaffold a new project directory with standard structure for Python, web, research, or competition projects.

root.description: Root directory for the project, defaults to Desktop

name: timer
description: Set a timer or pomodoro session for focused work. Check timer status with action=status.

action.description: Start new timer or check current status

name: meeting_template
description: Generate a meeting notes template with agenda, decisions, action items sections. Saves as a markdown file.

name: ls
description: List directory contents with filtering by pattern, recursive option, sorting by name/size/modified time

name: cat
description: Read file contents with optional line range selection. Returns total lines and content.

name: find_files
description: Search files by name pattern recursively in a directory tree. Returns matching files with metadata.

name: grep_text
description: Search text content in files within a directory. Like grep, returns matching lines with file and line number.

path.description: Directory or file path to search

name: file_info
description: Get detailed file metadata: size, created/modified/accessed timestamps, permissions, extension

name: code_stats
description: Count lines of code by programming language in a directory. Detects Python, JS, TS, Go, Rust, C, Java, HTML, CSS, Markdown and more.

name: find_todos
description: Find TODO, FIXME, HACK, NOTE, XXX, BUG comments in source code files

path.description: Directory or file path to scan

name: dir_tree
description: Render a visual directory tree structure showing folder hierarchy

name: memory_profile_set
description: Set a user profile field in MemoryOS (name, interests, skills, research direction, etc.)

name: memory_profile_get
description: Get user profile info from MemoryOS. If key is empty, returns all profiles.

key.description: Profile field name to retrieve, empty for all

name: memory_preference_set
description: Set a user preference in MemoryOS (writing style, code style, communication preference, etc.)

name: memory_preference_get
description: Get user preferences from MemoryOS

name: memory_stats
description: Get MemoryOS statistics: profile count, preference count, conversation count, project count

name: memory_history
description: Get recent conversation history from MemoryOS for a session

name: reflection_trigger
description: Trigger a reflection cycle on recent conversations and tool executions. Analyzes successes and failures, extracts lessons, and stores in MemoryOS.

name: reflection_list
description: List recent reflection cards stored in MemoryOS with outcomes and lessons learned.

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return

name: file_write
description: Write content to a file on disk. Creates parent directories automatically. Use this to save generated code, notes, or any text output to a file.

path.description: Full file path including filename and extension

content.description: Text content to write to the file

append.description: If true, append to existing file instead of overwriting

name: shell_exec
description: Execute a shell command on the local machine (Windows uses PowerShell, Linux uses bash). Use for: compiling code, running scripts, checking installed tools. Max 60 seconds. Returns exit_code, stdout, stderr.

workdir.description: Working directory, defaults to current dir
